issues.description: Lyrics are missing, unavailable, or fail to load for songs.
Reviews express broad frustration with premium prompts or payment, with separate complaints about family account address requirements and an unexpected charge.
Users report that core listening controls, including song choice, skipping, or seeking, require Premium.
Reviews broadly object to basic features being moved behind Premium without identifying one specific feature problem.
Most reviews give nonspecific negative feedback about customer service, while others mention repetitive responses and a separate concern about home page scrolling.
